name: Vancouver Youth Parliament (VYP)
what_you_do: Debate real issues in a mock parliament over a weekend. Then join the fundraising and service events for the year.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18 as of Dec 31, in the Vancouver region. This includes Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Burnaby and Richmond. A youth group, like a school or community group, must name you. Five members of that group must sign.
pay_detail: $60 registration fee; financial help may be asked for by email
duration: One weekend session plus events during the year
deadline_text: The 39th session (Feb 6 to 8, 2026) closed applications Feb 1, 2026. The next one is expected around the same time.
how_to_apply: Download the form. Find a sponsor group and five people to name you. Add a personal note if you did not take part last year. Fill out the online form and upload your files.
notes: Contact vyp@bcyp.org for session questions and registrar@bcyp.org for applying. The 40th session dates were not posted when read.
